To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the implementation of ISO 9001 in medium-sized enterprises is associated with a decrease in accident risk.

the implementation of ISO 9001 in large companies is associated with a decrease in the number of accidents, and that the implementation of value analysis in companies is associated with an increase in the number of injuries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of organizational changes on the risk of accidents.
the impact of organizational change on the risk of occupational accidents.
the relationship between the introduction of new forms of work organization and the risk of accidents at work.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the introduction of new forms of organisation of work in the enterprise is not systematically associated with a reduction of the accident rate.
the introduction of ISO 9001 and the analysis of value are associated with the reduction of the risk of accidents in large firms.
the implementation of ISO 9001 and the introduction of the value analysis in an enterprise are associated with a reduction of the accident rate, but only in the case of large enterprises.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the ISO 9001 standard is associated with a reduction of accidents in larger firms.
the introduction of organizational innovations is correlated to the risk of accidents.

the introduction of new organizational forms of work, such as the Toyota production system (just-in-time production, autonomous work teams, etc.) is associated with lower accident rates, but only in large enterprises.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a need for a more systematic evaluation of the effects of organizational change on occupational safety and health, and that the effects of organizational changes should be evaluated with the use of appropriate econometric models.
the introduction of the Toyota production system (TPS) is associated with a reduction of the risk of work-related accidents.
the ISO certification is associated with a lower accident rate in large enterprises, while it is associated with a higher accident rate in small enterprises.
